    • setRaw

      public CssStyleResolver.Builder setRaw(String propertyName, String value)
      Sets a raw property value for lazy conversion.

      Raw values are stored by property name and converted lazily when accessed via CssStyleResolver.get(PropertyDefinition). This enables widget-defined properties to be resolved from CSS without requiring the CSS engine to know all property definitions.

      Parameters:
      propertyName - the CSS property name
      value - the raw CSS value (already variable-resolved)
      Returns:
      this builder

    • markAsInherited

      public CssStyleResolver.Builder markAsInherited(String propertyName)
      Marks a property as using the "inherit" keyword.

      This indicates that the child element wants to explicitly inherit this property's value from its parent, regardless of whether the property is normally inheritable.

      Parameters:
      propertyName - the CSS property name
      Returns:
      this builder
